d:
Bihar men vidhanasbha chunav ke pahle charan ka matdan aaj yani guruvar (6 navanbar) ko huaa. pahle charan men 18 zilon ki 121 vidhanasbha siton par vot dale gae. inmen se ek sit mokama ki bhi hai. mokama se jansuraj parti ke ummidvar piyush priydarshi ke samarthak dularchand yadav ki hatya aur jediyu ke bahubli neta anant sinh ki giraftari ke bad se hi yah kshetr charcha men hai. voting ke din kaisa raha yahan ka hal...yahan ke votars ne kin muddon par kiya matdan... zyada jankari de rahe hain bibisi sanvaddata rajnish kumar.
Vidiyo: dipak jasrotiya
